Interface FiltersListener

All Superinterfaces:
org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.ParseTreeListener
All Known Implementing Classes:
FiltersBaseListener
public interface FiltersListener extends org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.ParseTreeListener
该接口定义了由 FiltersParser 生成的解析树的完整监听器。
